circle_level_observations.text: The final five cover the interview-documented daily/weekly personal-text contacts: Valentina (daily voice memos, Q05), Priya Raman (weekly Tuesday ritual, Q07/Q44), Elena (WhatsApp family group chat, Q48), Mateo (brother + Maya gateway, Q05/Q46), and Sofia (weekly hike coordinator, Q07/Q15). No daily-or-weekly-frequency contact from the interview is missing.

Other interview-named personal contacts (Jamal, Marcus, Ben, niece Maya, abuela Lucía, father Rafael) are intentionally omitted. Jamal is primarily a work/hackathon partner (Q07, Q77) and would likely use work channels; Marcus is a studio-neighbor friend but not described with messaging frequency; Ben is only 2 months / 6 dates in (Q07, Q18) and texting volume is below the top-5 threshold; Maya (age 6) communicates via FaceTime, not text; abuela Lucía uses phone calls in Spanish, not text (Q05 — she's 84, barely speaks English, bi-weekly phone calls); Rafael is reached via the family WhatsApp group chat mediated through Elena. Omissions are defensible.

Diversity check: the five include 4 women and 1 man; ages span 29-61; family blood-ties (3: mom, brother, cousin) balanced with chosen-family (2: best friend, local hike organizer); geography spans Sacramento, San Jose, Oakland (x2), and Chico local. Interview evidence supports female-skewed emotional network (Priya, Valentina, Elena are the documented deep-contact triad), so the skew is evidence-driven, not artifact.

Name-collision handling: the interview documents two distinct Priyas (Q07: 'different Priya than my sister-in-law'). The social circle entry includes only Priya Raman (best friend / Oakland data scientist) and correctly distinguishes her from sister-in-law Priya. No confusion in the output.

verification.verdict_rationale: All 25 observations (15 per-person D1, 11 per-person D2, 4 circle-level) are verdict=consistent. No INCONSISTENT findings, no REPLACE_PERSON / PARTIAL_UPDATE / FLAG_FOR_REVIEW actions, and no ENRICH_FROM_INTERVIEW / DROP_FROM_CIRCLE / ADD_TO_CIRCLE dispositions. Gap observations (9 total) are all CARRY_FORWARD — inferred demographic details (ages, surnames, occupations for non-named-in-detail figures like Sofia, Mateo's employer, Valentina's education) that reasonably extend the interview evidence without contradicting it. All five members are either explicitly named in the interview or anchored to a named figure.
